title: Primary care management of patients with dementia in a rural area
summary: This study explores how care for people with dementia is provided in primary care practices in rural areas. Interviews with general practitioners will address different aspects of care, including diagnosis, treatment, collaboration with other healthcare professionals, and support for family caregivers. In addition, participants will be asked about their experiences and possible ways to improve dementia care.

interventions.name: General practitioners from a rural region will be interviewed once within the framework of semi-structured, guideline-based individual interviews regarding their experiences, perceptions, and approaches to the care of people with dementia. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-Licensed general practitioners, practical physicians, specialists in general practice, or specialists in internal medicine working in primary care
-Currently practicing in the defined study region (within a 15 km radius of the two participating hospitals)
-Capacity to provide informed consent
-Sufficient German language skills to participate in an interview
Exclusion criteria:
-No primary care practice within the defined study region
-No licensure as a general practitioner, practical physician, specialist in general practice, or specialist in internal medicine working in primary care
-Lack of capacity to provide informed consent
-Insufficient German language skills to participate in an interview
